name: Samhair

attributes.attribute: an Irish heroine, daughter of Fionn mac Cumhaill
the husband of Samhair, who built her the fort of the three pillars

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Samhair is an Irish heroine. She is the daughter of the great hero Fionn mac Cumhaill. Her husband Cormac Cas built her a fort in her honor. The fort was called Dun-tri-lag, the fort of the three pillars. The name came from the bed he raised on three great pillars to please her. The site is now remembered as Duntryleague, in County Limerick. Her story is short. It fixes her in a place and in the line of a famous hero's children. Her name links the world of Fionn to the hidden ground of Limerick. Much of her memory survives in that one place name.
objective: Document Samhair, daughter of the hero.
